keep: Keep EVERYTHING else exactly identical: the same face, hair, bangs, head angle, position and size in the frame, the same fine pen-and-ink linework and cross-hatching, the same flat indigo second colour, the same white paper. Only the eyes change. No new colours, no grey wash.

closed.prompt: Change ONLY her eyes: both eyes gently closed, the upper lash line lowered into a soft downward curve with the lashes still drawn in ink, no iris visible.

half.prompt: Change ONLY her eyes: both eyes half closed, the upper eyelids lowered to cover the top half of the indigo irises, the quotation-mark catchlight still visible below the lid.
